findings.summary: The F-1 container query measures the workspace without a classic scrollbar, so on classic-scrollbar platforms the one-column switch happens about 15px earlier than the old viewport media query; no test guards the default-text breakpoint.
The shipped VI chip copy is not owner-confirmed after Q3/Q7 changed it, and the resolution overstated that confirmed phrases were kept.
The only space between the author name and the later-reply note sat inside the aria-hidden separator, so assistive technology may read 'e-agentnot verified'.
